newsitem.title: FINLAND: LAROX JOINS OTC RALLY, HITS 20-MTH HIGH.
newsitem.headline: LAROX JOINS OTC RALLY, HITS 20-MTH HIGH.

text.p: Finnish industrial filter and valve maker Larox Oy rose sharply in fair trade on Friday as investors continued to search for attractive stocks on the OTC list, brokers said.
At 1635/1435 GMT, Larox traded up 2.00 markka or more than five percent at 40.00 markka -- its highest since February 17, 1995. Trade was 0.7 million markka, which is fair volume for Larox.
The OTC-index was at a new new all time high 2,297.32, up 0.26 percent. The previous 2,291.45 high was set on Thursday.
"Players are searching for small firms with good earnings prospects. Larox is probably such a company" one broker said.

Larox said in August it expects a 20 percent net sales rise in 1996. It did not give comparable full-year figures from 1995, but said its January-June net sales increased 36.5 percent to 118.2 million markka.
Larox had a 7.4 million markka profit before extraordinaries in January-June, up from 5.3 million markka loss in the first six months in 1995.
